column3: Close to the Hebrew; the title מַשְׂכִּיל (“a maskil”) is rendered “A Psalm of David. A Contemplation.”
Close to the Hebrew; בָּלוּ (“wasted away”) is rendered “grew old.”
Close to the Hebrew; לְשַׁדִּי (“my moisture, sap”) is rendered “My vitality.”
Close to the Hebrew; “at a time of finding” is rendered “In a time when You may be found.”
Close to the Hebrew; “shouts of deliverance” is rendered “songs of deliverance.”
Close to the Hebrew; “its trappings are to restrain” is rendered “Which must be harnessed.”
